name: The Cafe
notes: All 4 photos were legible printed menu pages (a two-sided lunch/entree card plus a two-sided breakfast/starters card). Photo 1 showed an older price version of the same sandwiches/entrees/desserts page (e.g. Fish & Chips $15, NY Steak $29) superseded by consistent prices across photos 2-4 (Fish & Chips $14, NY Steak $27); photo 1's prices were dropped in favor of the newer, internally consistent set. A featured cocktails list (Bloody Mary, Mimosa, Sangria) on photo 2 was skipped per the drink-only rule.
